body: Forward test of the decision-card method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.15 (base rate 0.154, class india_nonfin_1000_20000cr_5y) that: YES if between 2026-11-23 and 2031-11-23: Close falls >= 80% below the entry price at any point within the horizon, OR delisting/insolvency/suspension, OR a regulator or auditor finding of fraud or misstatement. No class above can measure this yet (survivor samples). Model: worksheet scenarios bear 30%→0.68x, base 40%→1.46x, bull 15%→2.85x with σ=0.35; reverse DCF base-case IRR 12.0%; card rule output: size 0: blocked by Expected value vs hurdle (EV 1.29x anchored (raw 1.24x) vs hurdle 1.76x → below hurdle → size 0). Score with Brier vs the base rate.

data.base_rate_reasoning: India non-financial, mcap Rs 1,000-20,000 cr at T, 5 yrs from 30-Sep-2016 and 30-Sep-2018 (survivorship-free, dead firms included, stratum-weighted). n=208 company-snapshots (54 distress-census D, 153 live L at weight 5.63, 1 delisted-other X at 4.26); 95% CIs (company bootstrap within stratum): P(>=3x) 14.1-28.7%, P(<=0.5x) 7.0-16.1%, P(blow-up) 10.2-21.4%. Two start dates only, and they disagree (2016: >=3x 16%, blow-up 21%; 2018: 26%, 10%). Price return only (no dividends, ~1%/yr). Blow-up = close <=0.2x the close at T, liquidation or compulsory delisting (no fraud field). Remaining survivorship leak toward FEWER failures (IBBI firms renamed/merged and 221 IBBI rows without identifiers missing; voluntary/merger delistings X under-covered). A survivors-only sample from the same frame says P(<=0.5x) 7% instead of 11%.
data.resolution_rule: YES if between 2026-11-23 and 2031-11-23: Close falls >= 80% below the entry price at any point within the horizon, OR delisting/insolvency/suspension, OR a regulator or auditor finding of fraud or misstatement. No class above can measure this yet (survivor samples).

body: Promise-credibility forward test, Nov-2026 cohort (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Shilpa Medicare (SHILPAMED). Probability 0.22 (naive sector base rate 0.22) that: Shilpa Medicare (SHILPAMED) commissions its integrated peptide manufacturing block by 31-Mar-2027. Probabilities set only by the pre-registered rule (research_notes/Promise tracker pilot/forward_test_2026-11/prereg.md s4): p0 = 0.222 (sector peers (Healthcare), all groups (group 'dates' n=2 < 8), n=9); N=1 < 3 so P_cred = P_base = 0.22. Evidence: call of 2026-08-05: "block will complete commissioning by end of FY27" (Q1FY27); "on track to commission one of the largest integrated peptide manufacturing capacities by the end of FY '27" (Q2FY27). Resolution: YES if a document dated <= 14-Jun-2027 states the peptide block was commissioned on or before 31-Mar-2027. Source: company Q3/Q4 FY27 filings, presentations and call transcripts (NSE). Resolve by 2027-06-14; score Brier of P_cred vs P_base (prereg s5).

data.adjustment_applied: p0 = 0.222 (sector peers (Healthcare), all groups (group 'dates' n=2 < 8), n=9); N=1 < 3 so P_cred = P_base = 0.22
data.adjustment_rule: P_cred = clip(p0 + N/(N+20) x SAC, 0.05, 0.95); SAC = mean(y - p0(group)) over the company's resolved past promises (strict: delivered=1, else 0); N<3 -> P_cred = p0. P_base = p0.
data.base_rate_reasoning: Naive forecaster = leave-one-out strict delivery rate of Healthcare peers in group 'dates' (sector peers (Healthcare), all groups (group 'dates' n=2 < 8), n=9). No company-specific information.
